title: unified_evidence
description: Output of the Evidence Aggregator (P4). Consolidated, deduplicated, and enriched evidence from all forensic tools.

case_id.description: Case ID from case_context.json for audit trail

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this aggregation was performed

tools_aggregated.description: List of tool names that were aggregated (e.g., ['volatility3', 'tshark', 'regripper'])

total_items.description: Total number of unique evidence items after deduplication

evidence_items.description: Consolidated evidence array, sorted by severity (critical→low) then by confidence (high→low)

evidence_by_type.description: Evidence items grouped by evidence_type for quick lookup

evidence_by_tool.description: Evidence items grouped by source_tool for provenance tracking
